AdmissionConsent.description:
An explicit, signed permission to show this membership acceptance to the group's
current and future admitted members. It never permits sharing the invitation or notes.

request_json.description: Original strict JSON, not a permissively parsed map that could erase duplicate keys.

ebook_identifiers.description:
Explicit ebook identifiers reported by the source, with their namespaces.
The audiobook ASIN is not implicitly a Kindle ASIN or an ebook ISBN.

ink.description: Absent on legacy typed blocks; never flattened into the text CRDT.

id.description: A portable catalog identifier, such as an ISBN URN or a provider identifier.

CanvasSpace.description: Absolute logical world coordinates. Moving the viewport never transforms saved strokes.

storage_key.description: Content-addressed local asset key, never an arbitrary absolute path.

LiteraryEntity.description: Literary entities never confer directory membership or operational permission.

NotebookInk.description: A logical canvas belonging to its containing stable notebook block.

native_drawing.description: Optional base64 native drawing. Portable strokes remain alongside native data.

acknowledged.description: Acknowledgments are recorded per intended recipient; no acknowledgment means retry.

oneOf.description: Both independently signed requests must be true before a friendship exists.
An owner-signed snapshot bootstraps an invitee without exposing private discovery.
Public consent enables independent verification of public group membership.
Adding members requires current consent: a private accepted invitation or public request.

replay.description: Receipt nonce -> exact event digest. Consumed in the same persistence transaction.

local_reader.description: Local attribution is not a Castalia identity and cannot authorize publication.
